However, the two genres do have quite a few similarities, which generally makes it so that someone who likes one will like the other. Because of that, bookstores, movie stores, and other such retailers will often put the two genres together to increase the likelihood of someone seeing more books/movies/whatever that they want and buy more. Stores used to generally not have a whole lot of fantasy or sci-fi stories, so they would generally group them together in one section (called Sci-Fi/Fantasy).
